BiblicalUsage: An increase here is a brood, an offspring. Moses tells the tribes of Reuben and Gad that they are risen up in their fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the Lord against Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a new generation can repeat the old sin, and Moses named it plainly before it happened.
